title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements the lazy tree transport slice and integrates QS-78 snapshot restoration without duplicating QS-54 cache work; re-measured and independently reproduced on 2026-08-24, then re-gated cleanly on 2026-08-27 as a strict descendant of origin/main f7557fb.
